text: FlowSOM.results supported SOM object completed SOM clustering. Supports FlowSOM objects kohonen objects returned som xyf. set.Required vector least five unique, strictly increasing integer cluster counts within SOM-node range. Values used literally. See inflect_adaptive_set_i construct explicitly bounded adaptive schedule. multicore Use parallel QC scoring platforms fork support. Default FALSE. cores Worker count multicore = TRUE. Must least two. NULL value uses detected core count minus one. zeroes.TRUE (default), retain negative, zero, positive finite transformed values. FALSE, exclude non-positive values, record per-marker counts, warn negatives present. .clustering.markers Evaluate clustering markers. kohonen object, markers first data layer. acquired_markers Marker names evaluate .clustering.markers = FALSE. basedata Use fitted "Curve" observed "Points" estimate inflection. ggtitle Optional title diagnostic plot. uniform.test Criterion used aggregate pass-rate curve: "" requires dip IQR pass, "unimodality" uses dip, "spread" uses IQR. Component evidence retained every run. th.pvalue Dip-test pass threshold. pair passes dip criterion p-value least value. Default 0.05. th.IQR Threshold rejecting marker distribution based inter-quartile range. Default arc-sinh transformed value 2. verbose Print progress messages. Default FALSE. max.n.diptest Optional integer cap number events used per cluster-marker dip test. dip test's power depends sample size, cap can used sensitivity analysis. Subsampling seeded deterministic; default NULL retains testable events. max.events.per.node Optional positive integer. set, SOM node sampled many events. shared event sample used dip IQR scoring across metaclusterings workers. Default NULL uses events. seed Non-negative integer base seed optional event sampling. Default 1L. target Target QC pass rate (fraction (0,1] percentage (1,100]) used report smallest tested k reaching threshold. Default 0.95. See inflect_threshold_k. ... Arguments pass dip.test FlowSOMQC.

title: Sarle's bimodality coefficient — bimodality.coefficient
text: Computes Sarle's bimodality coefficient (BC) numeric sample, fast moment-based screen bimodality: $$BC = (g^2 + 1) / (k + 3 (n-1)^2 / ((n-2)(n-3)))$$ \(g\) sample skewness \(k\) sample excess kurtosis. BC lies (0, 1]; benchmark 5/9 (0.555) value uniform distribution, larger values indicate bimodal shape. BC moment-based diagnostic can complement dip-test evidence retained fastINFLECT. deliberately default QC statistic: driven skewness kurtosis can flag heavy-tailed strongly skewed single-mode markers (common cytometry) bimodal. Use rank marker-cluster pairs follow-explicit distributional tests plots.

text: set.required literal. must contain least five unique, strictly increasing integer cluster counts within SOM-node range. Two-value inputs c(25, 100) fail spacing ambiguous.
